{{Quote|&hellip;a planet that has three suns. There can't be many systems like that&mdash;in fact, only one. Riflor.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]|<ref name="Republic 62">[[Republic 62|''Republic'' 62]]</ref>}}
'''Riflor''' was a tectonically active [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the trinary [[Star system/Legends|star system]] of [[Riflorii system|Riflorii]] on the [[Cerean Reach/Legends|Cerean Reach]] with a tendency to change its gravitational pull. The native population was known for its bureaucracy and engineering accomplishments.

==Description==
A planet ravaged by tectonic instability and geothermal vents, the harsh landscape was dotted by volcanic activity and destroyed civilizations. Native fungi grew around the vents and few other locations with a steady source of water. The native [[Advozse/Legends|Advozsec]] evolved out of [[Reptile/Legends|reptile]]-analogs, adapting to the harsh environs and low-level of sun light that pierced the dense cloud cover of the world.<ref name="g4" />

==History==
[[File:Riflor.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The approach to Riflor.]]
A civilization of [[Reptomammal/Legends|reptomammals]], the [[Advozse/Legends|Advozsec]] were able to eke out an existence on their unstable world, though they grew pessimistic as a culture and learning to adapt their construction habits to prevent widespread catastrophe. Developing their own [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] technology before making contact with the greater galaxy, the Advozsec drew the attention of scouts from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] circa [[10,000 BBY]]. Gaining representation in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the species was often perceived as being decent bureaucrats.

During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], the constant [[Groundquake/Legends|earthquakes]] caused for the ruinous [[City/Legends|city]] walls to sway back and forth like ocean waves. The ancient ruins were ransacked for resources at the time.<ref name="Shaky">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Scavenging|Shaky Ground}}</ref>

When the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] erupted between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Riflor's [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Silvu Donte]] attempted to secede from the Republic but the planet was quickly placed under the guardianship of the [[Nineteenth Army|19th Sector Army]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] and was unable to support the Separatist cause in any substantial way. Despite this, a strong Separatist leaning permeated the society and representatives of the Republic were not welcome. This was discovered by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] when he crash-landed on the planet and was assaulted by a gang of [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] on the planet. While the spacers engaged the Jedi in combat, the native population did not take up arms against the Jedi.<ref name="Republic 62" />

When the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] came to power, Advozsec involved in Riflor's rich mining operations were cut off from planetary decision making by their Imperial overseers. While most Advozsec supported the Empire, with many serving in its bureaucracy, the Imperial forces on Riflor had to put down several protests demanding a greater Advozse voice. In the decades following the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the world was [[Biological attack on Riflor|attacked]] by the [[Extragalactic/Legends|extragalactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] as they waged their [[Yuuzhan Vong War|campaign of conquest and terror]] across the galaxy. Creating a bio-virus which killed off Riflor's plant life, the Advozsec who remained on the world died of malnutrition. The species survived only through those Advozsec found on other planets and colonies.<ref name="LECG" />
